title: Observation
description: One claim from one tool run about a potential security concern ("Smoke"). An Observation is immutable once emitted: it carries exactly what the source tool reported, never a corrected or merged view. Fireline core assigns id, fingerprint, and ingestion time on receipt — an adapter never claims those.

schema_version.description: Wire contract version this Observation was built against.

source.description: The tool and rule that produced this Observation.

tool_version.description: Version string of the tool that ran, if known.

rule_id.description: The tool's own identifier for what fired: a Semgrep rule id, a CVE, a Nuclei template id, an OSV id.

identity_components.description: Free-form key/value bag a source uses to identify what it found (e.g. package + ecosystem for SCA, file + line + rule for SAST, host + port for DAST). Deliberately not a closed schema per source type in v1 — different scanner classes have genuinely different identity shapes. Fireline core computes a versioned fingerprint from these values; it never treats them as the fingerprint itself.

severity_raw.description: Severity exactly as the source tool reported it, verbatim. Never collapsed into a normalized score here — that erases information a Fireline rule may need.

raw_payload.description: The original tool-output fragment this Observation was built from, preserved so source truth is never lost to normalization.

observed_at.description: When the source tool run occurred, distinct from when Fireline core ingested the Observation.
